scope: P2 reference-data contribution; statuses describe cited data readiness, not drawing pass/fail or check implementation.

status_definitions.reference_ready: Required reference data are transcribed for the stated source scope; check/feature integration and policy confirmation are separate.
status_definitions.reference_partial: Useful cited data supplied; a source/approval gap prevents full reference coverage.
status_definitions.source_needed: Required source/standard has not been established; no values are fabricated.
